title.narrative: Revitalizacin de Barrios e Infraestructura Patrimonial Emblemtica
Revitalization of Neighborhoods and Heritage Infrastructure

description.narrative: El objetivo de la operacin es implementar nuevos modelos de gestin para larevitalizacin de barrios e infraestructura patrimonial emblemtica, con el propsito de: (i) mejorar las condiciones de habitabilidad y del entorno de barrios de la poblacin residente; (ii) poner en valor sus inmuebles patrimoniales; (iii) incrementar su actividad comercial y cultural; y (iv) fomentar la participacin de sus residentes en su revitalizacin.

The objective of this operation is to implement new management models for the revitalization of neighborhoods and heritage infrastructure, with a view to: (i) improving the habitability conditions and neighborhood environment of the resident population; (ii) developing neighborhood structures with heritage value; (iii) boosting neighborhood business and cultural activities; and (iv) encouraging resident participation in the revitalization efforts.
